line.en: the winter craft market: makers and handmade goods in the festival pavilion. free entry with a suggested $5; open 11 to 5 on saturday and sunday.
line.de: der winter-craftmarkt: macherinnen und handgemachtes in der festival pavilion. eintritt frei, vorgeschlagen 5 dollar; samstag und sonntag von 11 bis 17 uhr.
line.tr: kış el sanatları pazarı: festival pavilion'da üreticiler ve elde yapılmış ürünler. giriş ücretsiz, önerilen 5 dolar; cumartesi ve pazar 11'den 17'ye.

sparks.why: Renegade Craft Fair San Francisco, 14 and 15 Nov 2026, Fort Mason Festival Pavilion, per renegadecraft.com; 11am to 5pm and free entry from a Fort Mason listing. Confirm on renegadecraft.com before going.
